scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: Yes, I can help with that. Your loan application with ID LOAN-01173 has been approved and originated.

dialogue.user: Great to hear! Can you share some details about the loan terms? What is my interest rate and the total loan costs? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.250%, and the total loan costs are $8,347.98. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. What is my loan term, and has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan term is 360 months, and it has been sold to Ginnie Mae. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Understood. What does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? And is there any other information I should be aware of regarding my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 38%, which means your monthly debt payments are 38% of your monthly income. That is all the information I have access to regarding your loan.

dialogue.user: Understood. Thank you for your help. <Satisfied> I appreciate the clear and detailed information you provided. It's good to know the status and terms of my loan.
